market_outlook.short_term: Volatile. Oil at $108 and rising diesel costs feed inflation, pressuring Fed toward hikes. Bond yields jumping (Bessent losing). Stocks resilient but dot-com comparison signals froth. Geopolitical headlines (Iran, Ukraine, Houthis) create whipsaw. Expect 5-8% volatility in equities over next 4-6 weeks.
market_outlook.long_term: Cautiously constructive. AI capex cycle (Oracle $30B, NVIDIA $10B Anthropic) supports earnings growth. GLP-1, AI security, and energy infrastructure are structural themes. But rate hikes + consumer stress could compress multiples by Q1 2027. Canada/EM rotation offers diversification. 6-12 month: +8-12% for diversified equity, +15% for energy, +20% for AI-security.
